Selected Young Professionals will sign a declaration of secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement before reporting. content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIRCOT
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology is part of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research and is located at Adenwala Road, Matunga, Mumbai 400 019. The Young Professional-II will work on the portable cotton quality instrument project, which has a likely completion date of June 2028.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate in B.E / B. Tech., or M.E / M. Tech., in Textile Technology / Electronics Engg. / Electrical Engg. / Instrumentation Engg. / Computer Science & Technology or Information Technology / Agricultural Engg. / Agricultural Structures and Process Engineering / Post Harvest Engineering and Technology / Farm Machinery and Power / Mechanical Engineering, OR any other relevant Engineering discipline. Candidates should possess 1st class or 60% marks or equivalent overall CGPA in graduate. Knowledge of design and development of instrument parts Operating 3D printer or any instrument Testing of electronic circuit boards Software development or coding skills Statistical Analysis Research paper/report writing The minimum age under the Young Professional category is 21 years and the maximum is 45 years. The application form asks for age as on the closing date of application. The notice does not mention any experience requirement. The notice states that the relaxation is permissible as per GOI rules. Candidates currently employed elsewhere must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer; those without a valid NOC will not be considered for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated amount of Rs. 42,000/- (Rupees Forty Two Thousand Only) per month will be paid to the selected Young Professional-II. The appointment is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project and may be terminated at any time. The engagement is for one year, extendable for two more years (one year at a time), subject to requirement of the services and satisfactory performance after evaluation by the Director, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai. The maximum duration is three years (1+1+1). Casual leave is 08 days in a calendar year on pro-rata basis, with 02 restricted holidays as per the rules of Govt. of India/ICAR. Un-availed leave is not carried forward to the next calendar year. Compensatory leave in lieu of duty on holidays may be allowed, but not more than 02 leaves can accrue in a month. It can be accumulated only up to 05 days at a time and may be availed within 03 months. Female Young Professionals are entitled to maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017. There is no paternity leave for male Young Professionals. No TA / DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining the post if selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional-II (Y.P.-II)
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format, Annexure-I, printed in the notice. It asks for personal details, education, experience, publications and a list of enclosures. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates in support of age, qualifications, experience and NOC. Complete the candidate's declaration given in the form. Email the application to [email protected] on or before 21 November 2026, 5:30 p.m. Bring all original documents at the time of the interview. Applications not in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) or found incomplete will not be considered. Candidates already working in a public or private organisation must also have the employer's certificate on the form completed (information verified from service records, no vigilance or disciplinary case pending or contemplated, and no minor or major penalty in the last ten years). Application in Annexure-I with recent passport size photograph Self-attested photocopies of certificates for age, qualifications, experience and NOC Bio-data and attested copies, along with original documents for verification at the interview Character certificate from the present employer and from the institute last attended (item 17 of the form) Declaration as per the appended proforma

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice provides for a hybrid mode interview for short listed candidates at ICAR-CIRCOT, Adenwala Road, Five Gardens, Matunga, Mumbai 400019. The application form asks candidates to state the mode of interview (Online/Offline). Reporting time is 10.00 am and interview time is 11:00 a.m. on 25 November 2026. No separate interview call letter will be issued to candidates. Candidates should ensure they fulfil all eligibility conditions. The decision of the Director, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai is final and binding regarding selection to the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional-II recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Young Professional-II (Y.P.-II) at ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 21 November 2026, 5:30 p.m. to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Young Professional-II at ICAR-CIRCOT?
faq.answer: A graduate in B.E / B. Tech., or M.E / M. Tech., in the listed engineering disciplines, or any other relevant Engineering discipline, with 1st class or 60% marks or equivalent overall CGPA in graduate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum is 45 years, with relaxation of 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST and 10 years for PH candidates as per GOI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: A consolidated Rs.42,000/- per month is paid to the selected Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I application with a recent passport size photograph and self-attested photocopies of age, qualification, experience and NOC certificates by email to [email protected] before the deadline, and bring all originals to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The hybrid mode interview is on 25 November 2026, with reporting at 10.00 am and the interview at 11:00 a.m., at ICAR-CIRCOT, Adenwala Road, Five Gardens, Matunga, Mumbai 400019.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Young Professional-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project, for 3 years or till project completion, whichever is earlier, and it does not constitute a regular job in ICAR.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA / DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post if selected.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently employed elsewhere must submit an NOC from their current employer, and those without a valid NOC will not be considered for the interview.
